description:
Find ready-made Tuney tracks that match a brief. Results are instant and previews are free.

        Give either a free-text prompt (for example "warm acoustic guitar for a travel vlog intro") or
        exact genre, mood and tempo values from list_styles. Each result has a cue_id and a preview
        URL. Pass the returned search_id to get more results for the same brief. Use adjust_track
        to change length or key, and download_track for the final file (that costs credits).
name: find_tracks
title: Find ready-made tracks
